ios.desc:
ArgoCD Mobile brings your Argo CD dashboard to your iPhone. Monitor deployments, trigger syncs, and stream pod logs — without opening a laptop.

FEATURES
• Real-time health and sync status across all your applications
• Filter by sync state, health, project, namespace, cluster, and labels
• Trigger sync, hard refresh, and rollback
• Stream pod logs with per-container selection
• SSO login via OIDC/PKCE — no passwords stored, tokens stay in iOS Keychain
• Username/password login as fallback
• Anonymous access for open Argo CD instances

PRIVACY FIRST
The app connects directly from your device to your self-hosted Argo CD server. No backend, no telemetry, no third-party SDKs. Your deployment data never leaves your control.

OPEN SOURCE
ArgoCD Mobile is free and MIT-licensed. The full source is on GitHub. Found a bug? Open an issue. Want a feature? Send a PR.

Requires a self-hosted Argo CD instance (v2.x or later) reachable from your device.
